fomod.Name: Isekai Hero
fomod.Author: dstNr
fomod.Description: Reincarnated into Skyrim with a System: a skill tree paid for in System Points, kill objectives handed out on the System's own schedule, threat readings over your enemies, a pocket-dimension storage and a shop to fill it from. REQUIRES Magelight UI 1.7.0 or newer (Nexus mod 193303), which draws every screen of the mod, besides SKSE and the Address Library. Install it first.
